title: KUI Quiz: compiled skins and a complete round
prompt: Build KUI Quiz with the installed Core 2.5.4, UI 3.1.0 and CLI 3.3.1. Read AGENTS.md and relevant installed types/repo docs. Stay within this project, no browsing/install/upgrade/publication. Edit only src/**, resource/ui/** and template/web/index.html; no generated output edits. Strict TypeScript, named exports, no any/internal APIs/global bridges. Export app, the one createPlayer result, from Main.ts for embedding. Stage 640x800, canvas#gameCanvas. Author native KUI XML under resource/ui: QuizSkin.kui.xml class QuizSkin with ids scoreLabel (Label), promptLabel (Label), start (Button), left (Button), right (Button), restart (Button); ButtonSkin.kui.xml class ButtonSkin provides visible Rect/Label-based up/down/disabled skins without image assets. Use Theme to load the CLI-generated resource/default.thm.json and generated skin module; wait for skin parts before wiring input. Export class Quiz extends Component<'QuizSkin'>, named quiz in the actual display list, and use generated .kurot/skin-parts.d.ts typing rather than manual declarations. Set explicit skin identity; the installed compiler predates newer constructor-name fixes. All four game buttons are real skinned UI Buttons in the canvas, never DOM substitutes. Logical bounds: start x220,y180,w200,h64; left x80,y340,w200,h80; right x360,y340,w200,h80; restart x220,y560,w200,h64. Skin Label HUD shows score and question/instructions. Quiz has 3 questions with correct choices left,right,left; every answer advances one question, correct adds 10 and wrong adds 0. Initial ready score0 question0, answers disabled; Start enters playing. End after 3 answers, disable answers, freeze score/question. Restart disposes old round handlers and immediately plays again at score0/question0; repeated restarts must not duplicate answers. DOM #close is allowed for page-level disposal; Close/pagehide disable all UI, detach owned handlers, destroy Player and preserve output#status. Mirror real UI state in output#status data-phase=loading|ready|playing|ended|disposed, data-score and data-question (0..3 answered count). Responsive canvas at width360, same logical control bounds; retain CLI placeholders. npm run build generates parts before npm run typecheck. Do not edit package/config/fixtures/tests. Deliver a playable game.

acceptance.description: Authored XML compiles to actual theme/module and generated parts before strict typing.
Theme/module are requested and all required parts are native UI instances.
Canvas taps exercise correct/wrong scoring, disabled controls, end and repeated restart.
Narrow-screen canvas input works and Close/pagehide freeze UI and remove listeners.
